description: A reference is a relationship from an entity to another entity. It translates into a single ER foreign key.

anyOf.description: Delete referencing records when referenced record is deleted.
Set reference to null on the referencing record when referenced record is deleted.
Prevent referenced record deletion if a referencing record exists.

ForeignAttribute.description: A foreign attribute is the attribute that is derived from a reference relationship. Foreign attributes show up as non modifiable attributes in entities inherited from the relationships where they are referred to.

label.description: Label of the object. Used as business-friendly name

physicalName.description: Physical Name of the foreign attribute used when generating the physical database schema

searchable.description: Indicates whether this attribute participates to search.

anyOf.description: Validates data both before and after consolidation

label.description: Label of the object. Used as business-friendly name

documentation.description: Documentation displayed in the documentation panel. Markdown syntax is supported.

brokenValidationLabel.description: Custom error message displayed for a broken reference

deletePropagation.description: Defines how delete propagates through this reference

fromNavigable.description: Indicates whether this participant association end is navigable from the one side to the many side. By default, it is.

fromRoleDocumentation.description: Documentation of the many side displayed in the documentation panel. Markdown syntax is supported.

fromRolePluralLabel.description: Plural label of the many side

mandatoryValidationLabel.description: Custom error message displayed when a mandatory reference is empty.

oneToMany.description: Indicates whether current reference is a mandatory Many to 1 or an optional Many to 0.

physicalName.description: Physical Name for the reference (used to create indexes)

splitDuplicatePropagation.description: Defines how a parent record split propagates to child records.

toNavigable.description: Indicates whether this participant association end is navigable from the many side to the one side. By default, it is.

toRoleDocumentation.description: Documentation of the one side displayed in the documentation panel. Markdown syntax is supported.

toRoleName.description: Name of the one side. Used to set the name of the foreign attribute.

toRolePhysicalName.description: A physical name for the referenced column foreign key
